title: Chemometrics-driven discrimination of flue-cured tobacco aroma types via GC-MS/MS and multivariate analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42354-42363
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02888D, Paper
Open Access

Hongjing Yang, Jiandong Zhang, Chen Liu, Kai Song, Yunzhen Gao, Jinbin Wei, Yanling Liu, Zhipeng Zang, Zhen Wang
In this work, a new chemometrics model to classify flue-cured tobacco aroma types based on 31 aroma components analyzed by GC-MS/MS. The model proved effective through multiple validation approaches.
